name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
directions: Preheat oven to 350° F and line two baking sheets with parchment paper
Mix flour, baking soda and salt together and set aside
In another bowl, cream together butter, brown and white sugar together until light and fluffy
Add egg and vanilla into the butter sugar mixture and whisk until well combined.
Slowly whisk in the flour mixture a 1/3 at a time until well combined
Add in chocolate chips and fold into dough until well combined
Shape dough into ~1 TBSP balls each and place onto baking sheet about 1 in apart from each other
Bake the cookies for about 12-14 minutes until edges are golden brown
Once done, let cookies cool for 5 to 10 minutes and enjoy!
